prompts.superHero:
Use case: ads-marketing. Create polished illustrated Microsoft Store artwork for Escape from 1829, matching reference image 1's rich forest-green dusk, red brick, warm amber windows, pale stone, subtle mist and fine painterly detail. Reference image 1 is the approved cover and style reference; reference image 2 is a factual architecture reference. Crucial invariant: the frontal hospital entrance must clearly display its entire white triangular pediment, with TWO vivid BLUE heraldic dragons with curling tails flanking the gold-and-blue coat of arms. These are sculpted/painted reliefs on the building, not living or flying dragons. Preserve the three-storey central frontage above the pale basement: three upper sash windows, three middle sash windows, lower red entrance door and flanking windows, white horizontal bands, white columned portico and steps. Do not invent towers, extra floors or giant animals. Keep the main frontage clearly visible and unobscured. No people, game UI, watermarks, ratings, platform badges or promotional claims.
Asset: untitled landscape SUPER HERO ART. Create a new 16:9 composition, target 3840 by 2160 pixels. Remove ALL lettering and numbers from the cover, including the title and tiny signs; artwork only. Centre the blue-dragon pediment and entrance in the image, with the pediment around 22% of image height, roof and entire central frontage visible. Keep pediment and entrance within the upper two-thirds, allowing a quiet misty pathway and low hedges across the bottom third for Store overlays. Expand the atmospheric grounds left and right with the same low brick wings, trees, dark foliage and warm dusk sky. Use modestly wider framing, not a stretched building. Make the dragons prominent and legible. Rich full-bleed illustration, no border, no text of any kind.
